_about: Post-processing settings of the Scapes style: the one place for their numbers. They are the settings object of core/image/adjust.js (brightness: levels 0..255 added to luma; saturation: multiplier of the colour difference from luma; sharpen: unsharp mask on luma, amount and Gaussian radius in px). neutral = no change. start = the starting settings per generation model (OpenRouter model id, "codex-cli", or "agent" for an image an agent made with its own tool and handed in with `ccf.mjs card import`, model unknown; a name instead of an object refers to another entry of this file, e.g. "neutral"), chosen on the trial cards: the measures they give and why are in RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке: цель и начальные настройки» and COLOUR.md «5. Насыщенность и яркость после генерации». sharpen_amount_max = the upper bound of sharpening on the trial cards (RENDERING.md, same section). Re-check on new generations with checks/adjust-trial.mjs. Per-card search (core/card/tune.js, run by the card loop after each generation): starts from `start`, measures the checks `tune_checks` (the aims of COLOUR.md «5. Насыщенность и яркость после генерации» → «Цель» and RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке» → «Цель»; COLOUR.15a–b apply only at night or dusk and COLOUR.15c only at golden hour or dusk, COLOUR.8 only with a hero outline confirmed by eye) against the bible's adjustment target where thresholds.json gives one, else the norm; and searches saturation × brightness (the COLOUR measures), then the sharpening amount (the RENDERING measures) within `bounds` (sharpening up to sharpen_amount_max) for the setting inside the aims with the smallest change. The bounds of saturation (0.8–1.45; the bible tried up to 1.45) and brightness (±20 levels), and the steps, are not bible numbers: chosen by the helper on the trial cards (2026-10-30), not decided by the author. Shadow lift (adjust.js `shadows`: levels added to black, fading out by mid-grey), by the author's decision (2026-10-30): scenes came out with darker darkest tones than the references (COLOUR.5b, L* of the darkest 1 %: factory scenes 11.5 against 16.6), so for a card whose staging matches `shadows.when` (a staging field and its lower bound: scenes, with characters) the search also moves the lift within bounds.shadows and measures `shadows.check` against `shadows.aim` instead of the check's norm (brightness is tried together with the lift: darkening an evening scene also darkens its darkest tones, and only a larger lift brings them back — one axis at a time refused every darker step; with this, Codex's golden-hour scenes come from median L* 66–69 down to 62.5–63, COLOUR.15c, measured 2026-10-30, the search of a scene taking about 18 s instead of 5); other cards keep no lift. The aim 15–19 is the lead's choice (2026-10-30) from the 30 reference scenes (25th–75th percentile 13.6–18.7, median 16.8; measured 2026-10-30 on references/ through checks/measures.mjs): the upper half of that middle range, so that the search, which takes the smallest change, lands scenes near the median rather than at the lower end; the bounds (0–40 levels, step 4) are the helper's, not the author's.
